bt.title: Border Tax
bt.periodEnd: {mode} — period khatam hone tak valid (date govt portal set karta hai)
bt.declare: Main confirm karta hoon ki gaadi ki details sahi hain aur sarkari portal ka declaration maanta hoon.
bt.freeNote: Members ke liye free — aap sirf sarkari tax bharte hain, official payment page par.
bt.historyEmpty: Aapki border tax filings yahan dikhengi.

filling.s: Aapke liye sarkari portal bhara ja raha hai

awaiting_captcha.s: Aage badhne ke liye dikhaya code likhein

handed_off.s: Payment ho gaya? Official site se receipt lein

failed.s: Yeh filing poori nahi ho saki

cancelled.s: Aapki request cancel ho gayi hai

awaiting_payment.s: Kisi bhi UPI app se pay karein

fail.captcha_timeout: Aapne time par code nahi likha. Dobara file karein.
fail.captcha_wrong: Code kai baar galat raha. Dobara file karein.
fail.portal_error: Sarkari portal mein dikkat hai. Kuch minute baad try karein.
fail.worker_restart: Sarkari portal mein dikkat hai. Kuch minute baad try karein.
fail.state_unsupported: Yeh state abhi available nahi hai.
fail.vehicle_pending: Is gaadi ka ek payment govt portal pe adhoora hai. Lagbhag 30 minute rukein, phir dobara bharein.
fail.already_paid: Is time ke liye tax pehle se bhara hai.
fail.road_tax_expired: Aapki gaadi ka road tax khatam ho gaya hai. Pehle renew karein.
fail.no_tax_mode: Is border par is gaadi ke liye portal mein tax option nahi hai.
fail.no_handoff: Portal ne bank page nahi khola. Dobara try karein.
fail.pucc_expired: Aapki gaadi ka pollution certificate (PUC) expire ho gaya hai. Renew karke dobara bharein.
fail.fitness_expired: Aapki gaadi ka fitness certificate expire ho gaya hai. Renew karke dobara bharein.
fail.no_qr: Govt payment page pe UPI QR nahi dikha. Dobara try karein.
fail.payment_failed: Payment nahi hua. Agar paise kate hain to support se baat karein.
fail.payment_timeout: Time pe payment nahi hua. Agar aapne pay kiya hai to support se baat karein — dobara pay na karein.
fail.payment_unknown: Payment page band ho gaya. Agar aapne pay kiya hai to support se baat karein — dobara pay na karein.

live.captchaSub: Hamara reader yeh code nahi padh saka. Jaisa dikhe waisa hi likhein, # ya @ bhi.
live.closedSub: Payment link lagbhag 5 minute chalta hai. Agar payment nahi kiya, to portal gaadi ko lagbhag 30 minute rok kar rakhta hai — uske baad dobara file karein.

gate.title: Seva members ke liye hai
gate.sub: EaseCab membership (₹149/mahina) ke saath border tax filing free hai.

errors.vehicleBusy: Is gaadi ki ek filing pehle se chal rahi hai — History dekhein.
errors.rateLimited: Bahut zyada filings. Ek ghante baad try karein.
errors.generic: Shuru nahi ho saka. Dobara try karein.
errors.busy: Govt site busy hai. {time} mein dobara try karein

prep.title: Aapka border tax payment taiyaar ho raha hai
prep.verify: Gaadi ki details check ho rahi hain
prep.fetch: Payment details li ja rahi hain
prep.redirect: Payment par bheja ja raha hai
prep.keepOpenS: Ye screen band na karein. Payment details yahin apne aap aa jayengi.
prep.queued: Thodi der mein shuru hoga — govt site har 2 minute mein ek check allow karti hai
prep.startsIn: {time} mein shuru — govt site har 2 minute mein ek lookup allow karti hai

pay.title: Payment Details
pay.note: Official sarkari payment page naye tab mein khulega. Link lagbhag 5 minute chalta hai. Agar pehle sarkari treasury page khule, toh wahan Continue dabayein. EaseCab kuch charge nahi karta.

bt.latestFee: Is border ki latest fee: {amount}, {n} din ({date})

qr.title: Border Tax bharein
qr.scan: Doosre phone se kisi bhi UPI app se scan karo, ya isi phone se pay karne ke liye upar tap karo.
qr.wait: Pay karne ke baad yeh screen khuli rakhein — aapki govt receipt yahin aayegi.
qr.noReceipt: Payment ho gaya, par govt receipt nahi aayi. Support se baat karein, hum nikaal denge.
qr.saveHint: Abhi apne phone mein save kar lo — hum ise {date}, {time} ko EaseCab se hata denge.
qr.receiptGone: Tax validity khatam hone ke 24 ghante baad receipt EaseCab se hata di gayi. Phone mein save ki hui copy use karo.
qr.gettingReceipt: Payment ho gaya. Govt site se aapki receipt la rahe hain…
qr.expired: QR ka time khatam. Check kar rahe hain ki payment aaya ya nahi…

unlock.error: Start nahi hua. Ek minute baad try karo.
unlock.queued: Govt portal pe lock hata rahe hain…
unlock.waiting: Portal ye gaadi {time} pe chhodega. Tab hum lock hata denge.
unlock.cleared: Lock hat gaya. Ab dobara file kar sakte ho.
unlock.paid: Pichla payment ho chuka tha. Receipt no. {no}
unlock.failed: Lock nahi hat paya. Support se baat karo.
